question: What changes about how a route runs if I declare it `async def`?
note: chosen over tutorial/dependencies/index.md#to-async-or-not-to-async, whose heading matches this question's central term and whose body repeats async def / normal def, yet it explicitly declines to answer ('It doesn't matter. FastAPI will know what to do') and dead-links to async.md, which was never vendored; this section is the only prose in the corpus naming the actual difference - an async def route runs on the event loop, where a blocking call blocks it, while a plain def route is handed to a threadpool worker
